reason: The original Bybit Spot 4h probe converted confirm with PowerShell == true; this can mask the original JSON type, and it stopped after only two nonclosed frames. A true closed-bar proof requires retaining the original raw JSON and checking authoritative 4h time semantics separately from historical continuity.
goal: Implement a strictly raw-JSON preserving, one-shot, read-only Bybit BTCUSDT SPOT 4h WebSocket collector for ONLY the fixed 2026-10-22 16:00–20:00 UTC candle, plus an independent downstream SOURCE-ONLY acceptance gate. No MR40 runtime, Paper or trades.
reject_early: Before 19:58 UTC must refuse before network. After 20:02 UTC must refuse before network. No automatic retry or scheduler.

raw_acceptance.true_boolean_confirmation: Use raw JSON parser to require Python type(confirm) is bool and confirm is True, not string or int and not PowerShell coerced comparison
raw_acceptance.message_shape: topic, type, ts and data[] retained unmodified with independent UTC receipt per update; topic=exact kline.240.BTCUSDT, type=snapshot, interval='240', start exact 2026-10-22T16:00Z, end exact 2026-10-22T19:59:59.999Z
raw_acceptance.as_of_validation: Server system ts and independently recorded UTC receipt both at or after 2026-10-22T20:00:00Z; no confirmed message before bar end; preserve data.timestamp but do not treat it as the authoritative signal-close clock (Bybit 1m sample showed it can be 564ms beyond candle end)
raw_acceptance.ohlcv: O,H,L,C positive finite Decimal; H>=max(O,C), L<=min(O,C), base volume >=0
raw_acceptance.same_candle_updates: Unconfirmed updates are diagnostics only. Repeated confirm=true must FAIL duplicate, not emit duplicate event.
raw_acceptance.read_only: Only op=subscribe, optional op=ping; never authenticate or send order; no exchange API keys.

continuity: The last SHA verified 4h bar still starts 2026-10-21T20:00Z; the four 4h closes Oct22 00:00/04:00/08:00/12:00 remain unresolved from official archive at protocol time. Even confirmed v2 realtime 16:00 candle cannot be admitted as an MR40 input until these intermediate bars are independently validated from authoritative Bybit Spot.
classification: One exact 4h websocket close observation. Not Bybit archive 4h parity, not a live strategy signal, not a fill, not OOS edge.
